viewing_check: Confirm date letter (u = 1815-16) and maker's mark SH under magnification; check bowls for thin wear, splits or repairs, and weigh the pair (53.5g). A known better maker (e.g. Hester Bateman family or Hennell) or crested/unusual engraving would add value; plain initial SH-type maker adds little.
